en.<i>Đọc to cả ba từ trước khi chọn. Chọn: Say all three words aloud before you choose. Choose the word whose ending sounds different from the other two.

en.<i>Với mỗi từ in đậm: (1) gạch chân đuôi: For each word in bold: (1) underline the -s/-es/-ed ending and write how it sounds: /s/, /z/, /ɪz/, /t/, /d/ or /ɪd/; (2) circle the stressed syllable. Then read the whole sentence aloud twice, saying every final sound clearly.
en.<i>Đọc câu hỏi và ba câu trả lời. Chọn c: Read the question and the three answers. Choose the one that answers directly, uses the right tense and gives details. Read your choice aloud.
en.<i>Câu trả lời ngắn chưa đủ ý. Nói lại c: The short answer is not enough. Say it again, then add details using the cues (each | starts a new sentence or idea). Speak first, then write.
en.<i>Câu trả lời nghe như học thuộc. Nói l: This answer sounds memorised. Say it again, replacing the general reason with the personal detail given. Then try it again with a real detail about you.
en.<i>Nghe câu hỏi, tìm tín hiệu về thì. Dù: Listen to the question and find the tense signal. Use the given phrases to say a short answer in the right tense. Speak first, then write.
en.<i>Nhìn gợi ý, nói to câu hoàn chỉnh (kh: Look at the cues, say the full sentence aloud (without reading), then write it. Each sentence has one topic phrase; use that exact phrase.
en.<i>Câu trả lời ngắn chưa đủ ý. Nói lại c: The short answer is not enough. Say it again, then extend it by 1–2 sentences using the cues (each | starts a new sentence or idea). Speak first, then write.
en.<i>Trả lời bằng 2-4 câu (khoảng 20-40 từ: Answer in 2–4 sentences (about 20–40 words). Use the given phrase and the technique in the hint. The suggestion is only an example; talk about your real life.
